svg.title: My Magic Map AGI system and AI architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing user inputs, browser-based TensorFlow models, the React experience, the secure Node and Express API, AMD Radeon ROCm image and vision services, OpenAI fallback and voice tasks, Google services, Databricks memory storage, and optional partner services.
svg.text: My Magic Map AGI — Runtime & AI Architecture
How body movement, maps, memories, voice, and explicit AI requests connect — implementation snapshot · August 2026

g.text: Camera frames remain local for tracking.
No OpenAI call; models run on the device.
Output: compact pose / hand / face signals
rather than uploading the live camera feed.
Stateful experience router: motion + place + memory + pet
Only sent after an explicit request.
Map motion · pet animation · frames · cards · voice · Web Audio soundtrack
Selected built-in voice; API key stays here.
Explicit request boundaries for image analysis.
Three APIs: Realtime · Responses · Images Edit
Does not synthesize the soundtrack audio.
Primary object vision, Paint, postcard, and virtual-memory path.
Authenticated FastAPI bridge; ComfyUI remains loopback-only.
48 GiB gfx1100 · HIP 7.2 · OpenAI retained only as a fallback.

svg.text: DIRECT WEBRTC AUDIO + EVENTS · after server-authenticated SDP handshake

g.text: User-selected real photos → server import → memory media
Durable personal memory + shared application state
User-scoped reads, cached statements, retry + circuit breaker
Map index supports closest-memory navigation and offline cache.
Object crops · full scenes · journal media
Returns authenticated media through server routes;
Optional live cards from AI-generated search terms
Retailer search links remain available when cards fail.
Web Audio synth · map-memory cache · canvas composition

svg.text: Privacy: live webcam tracking is local. Selected Street View images reach AI only after an explicit request. API keys and Databricks credentials remain server-side.
